blacklistabilityReview.evidence: sYUSD resolves Possible, not Yes. Ethereum holds 99.9902% of supply (2026-10-19 supply data); BSC 0.0098% is sub-threshold. At Ethereum block 26224780 (2026-10-19T06:18:11Z), sYUSD 0xfe0ccc9942e98c963fe6b4e5194eb6e3baa4cb64 is a TransparentUpgradeableProxy with EIP-1967 implementation 0xb0c63bB1667b6e9215AEe562aF2957739B2676fE and admin 0x5b35fCa1874083000a6Ef64fF27C891f311282a9; the admin contract's owner() is 0x4Fe78eF65BD8EDDED480efaB030BA680646503c8. The verified implementation is an ERC-4626 vault with ADMIN_ROLE-settable cooldown (maximum 90 days), instant-unstaking fee, rescueTokens, and proxy-admin upgradeability; it has no blacklist, freeze, transfer allowlist, or owner/receiver-keyed withdrawal gate. Cooldown and fee changes are global and cannot target a holder, so they do not create Yes. The declared parent YUSD resolves Yes (95.2681% Ethereum deployment with owner blacklist) and sYUSD is a 100% YUSD claim, but a direct Possible surface is not narrowed by upstream exposure.

oracleRisk.summary: sYUSD is an ERC-4626 staking receipt over YUSD whose exchange rate accrues strategy yield; it is not a borrower debt market with collateral liquidation oracles.

branchApplicability.reviewer: OpenAI Codex W1b oracle applicability review
branchApplicability.rationale: Aegis's sYUSD is an ERC-4626 staking receipt whose exchange rate grows as YUSD strategy rewards accrue and is used for unstaking after the cooldown. That share-price/exchange-rate path is a price-sensitive top-level valuation authority; sYUSD has no borrower-owned debt or liquidation branches, so the disposition is top-level-only.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Both authored sYUSD deployments are local Aegis ERC-4626 wrappers over chain-local YUSD, not bridge representations. The reviewed contracts expose deposit/mint and withdrawal/cooldown share accounting but no sYUSD LayerZero/OFT, peer, endpoint, lockbox, adapter, validator/DVN, cross-chain mint/burn, or rate-limit machinery. The parent YUSD LayerZero mesh remains assessed only under yusd-aegis Bridge Risk.
